summary: Listing a seat's transcript directory no longer makes the prompt cards' watcher start over: on Linux a read of the directory was taken for a lost watch, so the next refresh rebuilt the watcher and subscribed every card again

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or CLI change. Removing or renaming a watched directory, an overflow, an event with no path and a watcher error still make the watcher again.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: No operator actions or configuration changes.
